defects.finding: Survey sample is 241 in the needs analysis and detailed CF activity narrative, but 200 in the CF target-group section.
Needs-analysis intro names 'Colegiul Energetic' although the benchmark project is Pleșoianu.
CF justification names 'Liceul Constantin Brancoveanu' as study-case school although the partner is Pleșoianu.
Adjacent chart values are repeatedly 86/105/50 while narrative for at least one question states 144/82/15.
Survey methodology states grades IX-XI while funded selection base is described as grades X-XII.
Historical analysis states 348 pupils and different specializations than current CF base of 274 pupils/qualifications; applicability must be versioned by submission date.
Key labour/economic evidence uses 2017-2019 observations even though the application was prepared in 2023-2024 and more recent official series existed.
Many national/region-wide claims are used to support a school-specific intervention without Vâlcea/Râmnicu Vâlcea corroboration.
Generic preschool-focused prose appears in an analysis for IPT high-school pupils.
'High discrimination among Romanian youth' is promoted to a diagnosed need without direct measurement in the displayed primary questionnaire.
CRPE agricultural-high-school evidence is generalized to Pleșoianu technical profiles without an explicit transferability test.
No atomic Need -> Evidence -> Cause -> Activity -> Output -> Result -> Indicator traceability matrix exists.
Many figures/charts lack precise table/dataset IDs, URLs, access dates or page-level provenance.
Some contextual claims cite broad entities/studies (e.g. GEA) without enough bibliographic identity to reproduce the claim.
Questionnaire conclusions are not stratified by grade/qualification and do not report coverage/response rate against the actual eligible base.
Some 'needs' are formulated as a justification of the preselected solution (stages/practice) rather than independently diagnosed deficits.
Need for competency alignment and need for early labour-market preparation overlap substantially and should be tested for duplication before ranking.
Current CF is version 28 from 2026, while historical needs analysis was uploaded 04.01.2024; post-award state must never contaminate historical blind reconstruction.

acceptance: All critical/high defect classes have a corresponding QA rule in QA_RULESET_v0.1.
